)

models.name: monthly_metrics

WITH completed_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT co.order_id, co.customer_id, co.order_date, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS order_revenue_cents
  FROM completed_orders co
  JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = co.order_id
  GROUP BY co.order_id, co.customer_id, co.order_date
),
months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS period FROM orders
),
customer_month AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.period,
         COALESCE(SUM(ot.order_revenue_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents,
         COUNT(ot.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months m
  LEFT JOIN order_totals ot
    ON ot.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND substr(ot.order_date, 1, 7) = m.period
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.period
)
SELECT customer_id, period, revenue_cents, order_count
FROM customer_month
